name: The Undercroft
description: A hidden warren of cutouts, handlers, and dead drops beneath the campus, the spine of the guild's espionage. Each tier lets the guild run more informants and more Veiled Concord contracts at once, and the deepest tier opens the cabal's lethal work.

tiers.description: A first quiet room and a handful of trusted couriers. Up to 2 informants may run at once and 1 Veiled Concord contract may be in play. Its couriers bring early word when a kingdom is halfway to the Teleport Sigil's pattern.

A standing corps of handlers works the networks so companions need not. Up to 4 informants and 2 contracts at once, and the Undercroft itself runs your assets, so unhandled informants take less heat from counter-intelligence. The handlers feed false patterns to anyone studying the Teleport Sigil: they learn it one step slower each moon, and a merely Unfriendly kingdom makes no progress at all.

Tradecraft deep enough to reach the Inner cabal. Up to 6 informants and 3 contracts at once. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. The Silent Floor: Assassination through the Veiled Concord, and every contract leaves a shorter shadow. Or the Whisper Market: sell the secrets your network holds to rival courts, for gold and favour.

doctrines.name: The Silent Floor
doctrines.description: Removal play. The guild may commission Assassination from the Veiled Concord, and every completed contract leaves a shorter shadow (1 less Marked).

doctrines.name: The Whisper Market
doctrines.description: Intelligence as currency. A secret the guild holds may be sold to a rival court instead of the Concord: gold by the courtier's weight, and their court's most influential courtier warms to the guild. The court the secret came from grows warier.
